body.text: How many nights in hospital vs recovery hotel are required after tummy tuck?

After a full abdominoplasty or combined mommy makeover, patients typically spend 2 to 3 nights in an accredited hospital for pain control, fluid monitoring, and assisted first walks, followed by 7 to 11 nights in a quiet recovery hotel close to the hospital. Total time in Türkiye should generally be 10 to 14 nights.

Abdominoplasty removes excess abdominal skin and fat while repairing separated abdominal muscles, as described by the [American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS)](https://www.plasticsurgery.org/cosmetic-procedures/tummy-tuck/surgeon). Because standing fully upright is difficult during the first week, choosing a hotel with step-free lobby access, reliable lifts, and room service is essential for realistic mommy makeover turkey logistics.

body.text: Why is combining too many procedures in one surgery medically risky?

Combining too many procedures in a single operation—such as a full abdominoplasty, breast surgery, 360-degree liposuction, and additional body lifts—extends general anaesthesia duration, increases blood loss, and raises the risk of deep vein thrombosis (DVT), wound breakdown, and infection. Staging extensive work across separate trips is often safer than compressing everything into one theatre slot.

While [ASPS notes](https://www.plasticsurgery.org/news/articles/two-procedures-in-one-why-patients-are-opting-to-combine-plastic-surgery-procedures-when-going-under-the-knife) that a mommy makeover commonly pairs a tummy tuck with breast surgery and targeted flank liposuction, clinical literature on [NIH PubMed Central](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4959979/) highlights that abdominoplasty carries one of the highest DVT risks among cosmetic procedures. Audits reported by [BAAPS](https://baaps.org.uk/media/press_releases/1900/sun_sea_necrosis_cheap_surgery_abroad_leaving_britons_disfigured_and_costing_the_nhs_millions/) further warn that aggressive, low-cost multi-procedure packages abroad drive serious post-operative complications. What compression garments, drains and lymphatic massage support are needed?

Most abdominoplasty patients wear a medical-grade abdominal binder or full compression faja continuously for several weeks to limit fluid build-up and support healing tissues. Surgical drains—when used by the surgeon—typically remain in place for 3 to 7 days until output drops, and gentle manual lymphatic drainage is only started once your operating surgeon explicitly clears it.

items: Confirm whether your hospital provides two compression garments so one can be washed while you wear the other.
Pack loose front-buttoning pyjamas, slip-on shoes, and a travel pillow to support a slightly flexed sleeping posture.
Never book external massage therapists without written timing approval from your licensed surgeon.
Arrange a travelling companion or vetted local support for the first 5 to 7 days, as lifting suitcases or bending is restricted.
Request English-language operative notes, drain-removal records, and medication instructions before discharge.

body.text: How soon can you safely fly long-haul after abdominoplasty?

The [NHS cosmetic surgery abroad guide](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) recommends waiting at least 7 to 10 days before flying after a tummy tuck, and long-haul flights over four hours generally warrant 10 to 14 days—or longer if combined with breast surgery or liposuction—once drains are out and your surgeon issues written fit-to-fly clearance.

As documented in the [CDC Yellow Book on travel-related DVT](https://www.cdc.gov/yellow-book/hcp/travel-air-sea/deep-vein-thrombosis-and-pulmonary-embolism.html), prolonged immobility on flights exceeding four hours compounds surgical blood-clot risk. faq.q: Can I stay in Türkiye for only 7 days after a mommy makeover?
faq.a: Seven days is usually too short for a combined mommy makeover. Allowing 10 to 14 nights provides safer recovery time for drain removal, incision inspection, and reducing DVT risk before flying.

faq.q: Do all tummy tucks require surgical drains?
faq.a: Not always. Some surgeons use progressive tension sutures to reduce fluid pockets, while others place drains for several days; this is strictly a clinical decision for your licensed surgeon.

faq.q: Should I book airport wheelchair assistance for the flight home?
faq.a: Yes. Even when cleared to fly, long terminal walks and heavy baggage strain abdominal sutures; pre-booked airport assistance protects your recovery.

faq.q: When can I stand completely straight after abdominoplasty?
faq.a: Many patients walk slightly hunched for the first 7 to 10 days to keep tension off the lower abdominal incision, straightening gradually as their surgeon advises.

faq.q: Can I combine a mommy makeover with sightseeing in Istanbul?
faq.a: No. A mommy makeover is major surgery requiring quiet rest, short supervised indoor walks, and scheduled follow-ups rather than tourist excursions.
